name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
tagline: Where the Indian Ocean meets the thrill of the unknown

topAttractions.name: Cellular Jail
topAttractions.description: A former British colonial prison turned museum, showcasing the history of the Indian independence movement

topAttractions.name: Ross Island
topAttractions.description: A picturesque island with remnants of a British colonial settlement, offering stunning views of the surrounding waters

topAttractions.name: Elephant Beach
topAttractions.description: A pristine beach with crystal-clear waters, perfect for snorkeling and swimming

bestTimeToVisit: October to May, when the weather is cooler and drier
culturalFact: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are home to the Sentinelese people, an indigenous tribe that has lived on North Sentinel Island for thousands of years, with their language and culture remaining largely uncontacted

hiddenGem.name: Diglipur
hiddenGem.description: A charming town on the north of Middle Andaman Island, known for its scenic beaches, waterfalls, and trekking trails

relatedFestival: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands celebrate the annual 'Island Tourism Festival' in November, showcasing the region's rich cultural heritage and natural beauty
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Cellular Jail or the Ross Island, they will appear here!
